answer: A juror that skips cases loses 12% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the ripple decay is applied at each close, the zephyr audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the marble fee to keep them eligible. A 466 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
